create_model_eurobert_base: create an EuroBertModel encoder with configurable hidden size, attention heads, and layers
build_masked_lm_eurobert: build an EuroBertForMaskedLM model for fill-in-the-middle token prediction tasks
run_sequence_classification_eurobert: run sequence classification with EuroBertForSequenceClassification using bos, mean, or late pooling
create_token_classifier_eurobert: create an EuroBertForTokenClassification model for per-token NER or tagging tasks
build_rmsnorm_layer: build an EuroBertRMSNorm layer equivalent to T5LayerNorm with configurable epsilon
